t: A warning aimed at a specific distraction
a: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تُلْهِكُمْ أَمْوَٰلُكُمْ وَلَآ أَوْلَـٰدُكُمْ عَن ذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَفْعَلْ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْخَـٰسِرُونَ
p: Yā ayyuha-lladhīna āmanū lā tulhikum amwālukum wa lā awlādukum ʿan dhikri-llāh…
m: O you who have believed, let not your wealth and your children divert you from the remembrance of Allāh. And whoever does that - then those are the losers.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
